title: Joonee Gamboa Returns to Deliver Spine-Chilling Tales in "Philippines' Most Haunted" Joonee Gamboa Hosts 'Philippines' Most Haunted' on ABS-CBN News
excerpt: Stream 'Philippines' Most Haunted' hosted by Joonee Gamboa on the ABS-CBN News YouTube channel. Explore Pinoy ghost stories and paranormal investigations.
content:
ABS-CBN News’ latest digital series began streaming on October 15, 2026

ABS-CBN News has officially launched its newest digital horror documentary series, “Philippines’ Most Haunted,” hosted by veteran actor Joonee Gamboa. The weekly series made its digital debut on October 15 at 8 PM, streaming exclusively on the ABS-CBN News YouTube Channel.

The premiere episode centers on an eerie, deserted mansion located in Northwestern Luzon. The property’s former residents share terrifying, firsthand testimonies of encounters with the spirits of an elderly woman and a young child. Joining the investigation is a paranormal expert who ventures inside the estate to actively attempt communication with the alleged entities.

Leveraging his signature commanding voice and deep storytelling presence, Joonee Gamboa serves as the ultimate guide through locally feared settings and generational ghost stories. The docuseries bridges Filipino folklore, real witness accounts, and on-site paranormal investigations to unpack these local mysteries and examine their lasting impact on the public consciousness.

This spine-chilling addition strengthens the media network’s expanding roster of digital programs on ABS-CBN Corporate, which has successfully captivated online audiences with content ranging from true crime to unusual subcultures. “Philippines’ Most Haunted” shares the digital space with other recently debuted titles, including the reality-focused “Philippines’ Oddest Jobs,” the lifestyle program “Oh My Gan!,” and the highly popular mystery show “Philippines’ Most Shocking Stories,” which is currently broadcasting its fourth season.

For more chills this Halloween season, viewers can also watch “Possessed: Real Stories from Filipino Exorcists,” hosted by John Arcilla; “Philippines’ Strangest Mysteries;” classic horror features from “Magandang Gabi… Bayan;” and Noli de Castro’s “Kababalaghan” specials, all available on demand on the ABS-CBN News YouTube channel.

Watch “Philippines’ Most Haunted” every Thursday at 8 PM beginning October 15 on the ABS-CBN News YouTube channel. It will also be available for streaming on iWant.

Visit and subscribe to ABS-CBN News’ YouTube channel for more exclusive documentaries and special features.
